name: @red-cup-engineering/semiotic-voxel-package-conformance-service
description: Validates x-semiotic-voxel as an exact package/deployment carrier descriptor and refuses package bodies that restore workspace authority, local dependency protocols, or ownerless identities.

scripts.verify: node --check src/assay-semiotic-voxel-package-body.mjs && node --check bin/assay-semiotic-voxel-package-body.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs

assay-semiotic-voxel-package-body.accepts: one repository territory whose named packages declare exact package/deployment carrier metadata under x-semiotic-voxel
assay-semiotic-voxel-package-body.returns: one package-body conformance receipt or a typed refusal; x-semiotic-voxel is never a network SemioticAtom, Mark, Utterance, ArticulationCell, or active voxel
